title: Designing an Unbiased Naturalistic Observation Study
description: Develop operational definitions and an observational coding protocol to minimize observer bias.
problemStatement:
Design a 20-minute naturalistic observation protocol to observe pro-social behavior (such as holding open doors or sharing seating) in a public setting (e.g., a library or cafe).

### Requirements:
1. Formulate clear, unambiguous **operational definitions** for the behaviors being observed.
2. Detail your sampling technique (time sampling vs event sampling).
3. Outline procedures to minimize **observer bias** and participant reactivity (Hawthorne effect).
4. Address ethical considerations regarding privacy and public observational data collection.
hints: Hint 1: Operational definitions must specify exact physical actions, not inferred intentions.
Hint 2: An observer who stays inconspicuous minimizes the Hawthorne effect.
